<module id="alu">
    <description>An arithmetic logic unit (ALU) for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Indicates if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Indicates if a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Indicates if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Indicates if an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    
    <!-- Parameter Description -->
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <!-- Logic Description -->
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of input operand a.</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of input operand b.</assign>
        <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to hold the result of the operation.</assign>
        
        <always @(*) begin
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res <= signed_a + signed_b;
                ADDU: res <= {1'b0, a} + {1'b0, b};
                SUB: res <= signed_a - signed_b;
                SUBU: res <= {1'b0, a} - {1'b0, b};
                AND: res <= a & b;
                OR: res <= a | b;
                XOR: res <= a ^ b;
                NOR: res <= ~(a | b);
                SLT: res <= ($signed(a) < $signed(b)) ? 32'h00000001 : 32'h00000000;
                SLTU: res <= ({1'b0, a} < {1'b0, b}) ? 32'h00000001 : 32'h00000000;
                SLL: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRL: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRA: res <= signed_b >>> a[4:0];
                SLLV: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRLV: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRAV: res <= signed_b >>> a[4:0];
                LUI: res <= {a[15:0], 16'd0};
                default: res <= 32'dx; // Default case to handle undefined values
            endcase
        end
        
        <assign id="flag" width_description="[0:0]">Flag indicating the result of SLT and SLTU operations.</assign>
        <assign id="zero" width_description="[0:0]">Zero flag indicating if the result is zero.</assign>
        <assign id="carry" width_description="[0:0]">Carry flag indicating if a carry occurred during the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="negative" width_description="[0:0]">Negative flag indicating if the result is negative.</assign>
        <assign id="overflow" width_description="[0:0]">Overflow flag indicating if an overflow occurred during the operation.</assign>
        
        <assign flag = (aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? 1'b1 : 1'bz;
        <assign zero = (res == 32'b0) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        <assign carry = (aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB) ? (res[32]) : 1'bz;
        <assign negative = (res[31] == 1) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        <assign overflow = ((aluc == ADD && (signed_a[31] == signed_b[31]) && (res[31] != signed_a[31])) ||
                           (aluc == SUB && (signed_a[31] != signed_b[31]) && (res[31] != signed_a[31]))) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>TODO: Inline implementation description.</implementation>
</module>
